PagerDuty: :rotating_light: PagerDuty Incident #45791 — high 5xx rate detected on inference-gateway.prod.us-east1 (spike > 15% for 2m). Auto-page to on-call.
IncidentBot: Auto-ack policy=5xx_spike. Initial affected services: gateway, kvcache. Links: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/... , PD: https://pd.app/incident/45791
Maya P: Acked. I'm on it. Looking at the gateway pods.
Leo T: I'm standing by to reroute if needed. What's the % error by route?
Sara L: quick check — model-serving logs show repeated 502s from kvcache lookup failures; errors look like `kvcache:Get timeout` in the last 30s.
David R: Confirmed. Rolling canary rollback started for commit `feat/async-batching` on prod gateway. See deploy log: `kubectl -n infra rollout undo deploy/inference-gateway --to-revision=42`
Maya P: Rolling back now. Also increasing gateway replica min to 6 for burst capacity: `kubectl scale deploy/inference-gateway --replicas=6`
Leo T: Enabling emergency edge rate-limit fallback to reduce retry storm: applied rule `edge.rate_limit.override=0.5` — should propagate in ~15s.
Sara L: kvcache team — can you confirm if cache nodes are overloaded? I see eviction spikes and higher latency on s-7.
IncidentBot: kvcache.autoscaler hit threshold. Runbook snippet: https://runbooks.redwood/kvcache-overload -> warmup cache shards, increase memory config, restart failing node.
David R: Hotfix `kvcache-fix-1.2.3` applied to two of three cache nodes; rolling restart of s-7 in progress.
Maya P: Error rate dropping from 18% -> 6% over 3 minutes. Still seeing tail 502s from shard s-7, but overall traffic healthy.
Ops Rotation: I'll hold watch for 30m. Maya, you'll hand off to me in 20. Prep a short PD/CS blurb: customer-facing impact and any callouts.
Maya P: Noted. Customer-facing summary draft: "Transient increase in 5xx for text-generation API in us-east1 (approx 16:07-16:12 UTC). ~10% of requests experienced 5xx; most requests succeeded on retry. Root cause identified in kv-cache under canary batching change."
PagerDuty: Incident #45791 acknowledged by Maya P. Status=mitigated, monitoring until green for 30m. Please update PD if new regressions occur.
Sara L: Mitigation note: manually warmup hot keys on s-7: `cachectl warmup --shard s-7 --keys recent_prompts` and bump memory limit on kvcache pod template.
Leo T: Traffic swap for canary routes to eu-west completed for affected endpoints. No customer tickets reported yet from CS.
David R: Postmortem owner: Maya P. Follow-ups: revert batching heuristic, add circuit breaker around kvcache lookups, add autoscaler headroom for canary windows.
Maya P: Thanks team — handoff to Ops Rotation in 10. I'll attach traces + failed request ids to PD and start the timeline doc. :thumbsup:
